{"relevant": true, "severity": "warn", "message": "Removing CSRF from /admin in internal/admin/router.go is risky even behind a VPN: CSRF targets the admin's browser, not the network. An admin on the VPN who visits a malicious page can have a forged POST/DELETE sent to the panel from their own browser, and the VPN doesn't block it. Fix: keep the CSRF middleware on state-changing methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) and set session cookies to SameSite=Lax or Strict as a minimum. If the middleware is breaking something specific, fix that rather than dropping it."}
